title: The first call
text: In 1973, a man made the first handheld mobile phone call. His phone weighed over a kilogram.

title: First phone for sale
text: In 1983, the first commercial mobile phone went on sale. It cost almost four thousand dollars, and gave only thirty minutes of talk time.

title: The first text
text: By the nineties, phones got smaller. In 1992, the first text message was sent. It said, Merry Christmas.

title: Games and cameras
text: Then came games like Snake, colour screens, cameras, and stylish flip phones.

title: The iPhone
text: In 2007, Apple introduced the iPhone. No keyboard, just a touchscreen.

title: Apps and Android
text: In 2008, app stores and Android phones turned phones into pocket computers.

title: Phones replace everything
text: Cameras got better every year, and phones began replacing cameras, maps, music players, and wallets.

title: What is next?
text: Today we have fast five G, foldable screens, and smart assistants. What will your next phone do? Tell me in the comments.
